title: OPT: Open Pre-trained Transformer Language Models
authors: S. Zhang, S. Roller, N. Goyal, et al. (19 authors)
before: GPT-3-scale models existed only behind APIs, with no access to weights.
problem: You cannot study a model's internals, biases or failure modes through an API.
breakthrough: A 175B model released to researchers, with the full training logbook including the failures.
why: The first at-scale open replication, and the logbook taught the community what large training runs actually feel like.
next: BLOOM, then LLaMA, then the open ecosystem proper.
inherits: The norm of releasing weights and documenting the process.
